notes: Every node is its own allocator.create(Node) with ?*Node children (null for a leaf), from init.gpa: std.heap.smp_allocator in a ReleaseFast build without libc (no arena).
Each tree is freed node by node with allocator.destroy right after its check; the long-lived tree is freed by a defer once the last line is written.
Digits are checked explicitly because std.fmt.parseInt also accepts a leading sign and '_' digit separators.
zig build-exe -O ReleaseFast -fstrip -mcpu baseline: no libc, a static binary on a scratch image; baseline x86-64 like the other compiled languages (Zig otherwise targets the build host's CPU).
